product.olivetti-m380-xp5.summary: The tower version announced for Europe in April 1988 with ten expansion positions.
product.olivetti-m380-xp5.history: The documentation places M380/XP5 as the tower version announced for Europe in April 1988 with ten expansion positions.
product.olivetti-m380-xp5.architecture: Memory organisation determines expansion options. The guide identifies BA814. All RAM resides on expansion boards.
product.olivetti-m380-xp5.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 2.0 · PBZ6/PBZ7.
product.olivetti-m380-xp5.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m380-xp5.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m380-xp5.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 8-1–8-2.
